sources: recreation.gov public campsite search API for asset 233742 (14 sites), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $26 a night in peak season (covers one driving vehicle, or an RV/trailer with its tow vehicle); $9 per extra vehicle, not covered by interagency passes. Off season (Oct 1 - Dec 1) no fee and no amenities.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/greek-creek-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night', 'Off Season, there is no fee and no amenities available', '$9.00 each additional vehicle. Interagency Passes not applicable toward additional vehicle fees') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233742/rates (2026 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 233742 (all 14 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 14 single-family sites (13 reservable on rec.gov). Paved campground roads, gravel parking spurs; 'Average Parking Spur: 30’ x 60’'. Camping fee covers 2 vehicles or an RV/trailer with tow vehicle; an extra vehicle must fit on the spur.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/greek-creek-campground ('Camp sites: 14', 'Average Parking Spur: 30’ x 60’') + recreation.gov catalog and notices, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Vault toilets, drinking water, trash collection; firewood sold. 'There are NO Shower facilities available at this campground.' 'No RV Dump Station is located in any of the USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest.'

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/greek-creek-campground ('Vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection are provided', 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233742 (notices), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Seasons of Use 5/16 – 9/30. Limited Service 10/1 – 12/1.' In the limited-service season there is no fee and no amenities.

13 of 14 sites reservable on recreation.gov (1-877-444-6777); one is first-come, and the rate table runs a first-come, first-served week before the peak season (2027: May 14-20). 16 consecutive nights maximum. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233742 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 16; notice 'Check In - 2:00 PM Check Out - 12:00 PM/Noon') + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season 2027-05-14 2027-05-20') + catalog (13 reservable, 1 not) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/greek-creek-campground ('For a map and to reserve a site click here 1-877-444-6777'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin National Forest campground in Gallatin Canyon off US-191 ~30 mi south of Bozeman, ~5,600 ft, on the Gallatin River under spruce, fir and cottonwood. Concession-run. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov: confirmed $26 (2026), no hookups, vault toilets, drinking water, reservable on rec.gov. Changed site count 16 -> 14 (FS and catalog). Added no showers, no dump, season May 16 - Sept 30 with limited service (free, no amenities) to Dec 1, some first-come (fcfs some_sites), 16-night max. Not stated: max rig length (only an 'average' 30x60 spur), booking window (rec.gov's slidingWindow value 16 is unclear; inherited 180 left). Note corrected (14 sites, 'average' not 'largest' spur) and trimmed.
